EPISODE ep_52ee4fd4dd6939ad; base currency USD; company timezone Asia/Dubai
Period: 2026-08-01T00:00+04:00 inclusive to 2026-09-01T00:00+04:00 exclusive; export until 2026-09-06T00:00+04:00.
RULES
- Amounts are integer minor units. Ledger amounts are in base USD; documents in their own currency. Exponents: CNY 2, USD 2.
- FX rate = USD per 1 unit of source currency, never inverted. Rate date = company-local date of issued_at (invoice, credit note) or of timestamp (payment, refund); if that date has no rate, use the last rate on or before it. base_minor = round_half_even(doc_minor * rate * 10**(exp(base) - exp(doc))), once per document total.
- Settlement: AR is relieved at the invoice's carried rate; differences go to 7100 gain / 7200 loss. A partial allocation relieves round(alloc * invoice rate); the allocation that clears the invoice relieves the remaining carried amount.
- Period: compare company-local dates (Asia/Dubai) after converting each timestamp. An invoice's AR posting must fall in the same period as its delivered_at; a payment's bank posting in the same period as its timestamp; a credit note posts at its issued_at. The opening entry (account 3000, at period start) carries prior-period invoices and is not an invoice posting.
- Allocation: a receipt allocates amount_minor + fee_minor to invoice_refs in listed order, up to each invoice's open amount (after credit notes); any excess goes to 2300 refunds payable at the payment rate; a receipt without refs goes to 2150 unapplied cash. Fees post to 6500.
- Billing: each delivery_ref is billed at most once; when two invoices bill the same delivery_ref, the later-issued one is the duplicate.
- Accounts: 1000-1070 bank, 1100 AR, 2150 unapplied cash, 2300 refunds payable, 3000 opening balance, 6500 bank charges, 7100 FX gain, 7200 FX loss.
FINDINGS (currency is always USD; amount tolerance 1 minor unit)
- duplicate_invoice: affected_ids = [original doc, duplicate doc]; amount = the duplicate's AR debit; evidence must include both docs + the duplicate's AR row.
- payment_allocation: affected_ids = [payment doc, invoice doc]; amount = AR under-credited for that invoice at its carried rate; evidence must include payment doc + invoice doc + the payment's AR row for that invoice (or its 2150 row for a base-currency payment) + the invoice-date fx row if the invoice is in a foreign currency.
- fx_conversion: affected_ids = [doc]; amount = |recorded - correct| base amount of its converted row (invoice: AR debit; credit note: AR credit; payment: bank row); evidence must include the doc + the prescribed fx row + that row.
- period_cutoff: affected_ids = [doc]; amount = the correct base amount (doc amount at the policy rate) of the mis-dated source row (AR for an invoice, bank for a payment); evidence must include the doc + the mis-dated row + the prescribed fx row if the doc is in a foreign currency.
- Evidence ids are ledger row_ids, doc_ids or fx ids.
